data.content: Plan review approved. The plan covers every acceptance criterion, keeps production compaction out of the design knot, and provides reproducible measurements plus executable safety cases. The generation-two namespace is feasible only with a hosting push-policy capability; the report must state that as a rollout prerequisite and must not claim current init-remote installs it. The test oracle must model exact cutoff membership rather than timestamps, transactional checkpoint application, and unchanged watermarks/quarantine on validation failure. The related follow-on knots avoid making this design artifact depend on implementing the protocol. No repository, database, or infrastructure mutation is planned.
